title: Syntax scan and literal parsing
statement: For every finite binary string $x$, the syntax scanner started in the clause state accepts the string obtained by prefixing $x$ with $1$ exactly when parsing that prefixed string succeeds and the scanner started in the clause state accepts the parser's remaining suffix. If parsing fails, the scanner rejects the prefixed string.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$, the string $1 :: x$ is accepted by the six-state formula
syntax scan from the clause-level state if and only if the literal parser succeeds on
$1 :: x$ with some remainder $r$ and $r$ is accepted by the scan from the clause-level
state; when the literal parser fails, the scan rejects.
